Huawei Cloud CCE Cluster Migrator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces an end-to-end assistant for migrating self-hosted, on-premise, or third-party Kubernetes clusters to Huawei Cloud CCE.
- Supports comprehensive migration of workloads, container images (SWR), multi-type persistent storage (EVS, SFS Turbo, OBS), ConfigMaps, Secrets, and workload backup/restore using Velero or k8clone.
- Assists with source cluster assessment, CCE sizing, network and security validation, and automated traffic cutover via Huawei Cloud Dedicated ELB and DNS.
- Provides prerequisite checklists, IAM policy requirements, and detailed migration phase workflows with references to supporting guides and checklists.
- Includes commands and tools for each migration step, ensuring consistent and validated migration processes.
